mode: Built-in image_gen; generate with identity/style reference images
basePrompt:
Create ONE finished portrait illustration for a website menu cover, vertical 2:3. Use the two reference images ONLY for the exact recurring adult male and adult female facial identities and Korean romance-fantasy illustration style. SAME adult faces: male has tousled wavy dark-brown hair, warm amber eyes, elegant angular face; female has long dark-brown hair, warm brown eyes, refined oval face. Preserve their attractive illustrated appearance, delicate crisp linework, polished jewel-like colors and believable painted light. This is a purpose-composed website thumbnail, NOT a tarot card: absolutely NO card frame, border, writing, numbers, letters, labels, logo or watermark. No pentacle motifs unless explicitly requested. Entire image filled with scene.
IMPORTANT composition: waist-up or chest-up adult, face large and centered horizontally, top of hair at 16% of image height, face at 28-40%, and ONE big meaningful prop at 52-70%. Keep all essential face and prop within the central 70% width and central 65% height so it remains recognizable in a tiny 76px portrait thumbnail AND a landscape center crop. Both shoulders naturally visible. Broad simple background masses with atmosphere, less busy than references. Rich original colors, warm daylight, no faded or gray filter, not photorealistic, not 3D, not watercolor. Dress beautifully in period fantasy clothing appropriate to each scene, not identical to reference. Female chest modest and proportional, no cleavage. All eyes visibly OPEN and expressive, relaxed brow. Anatomically correct: exactly two arms per figure, no duplicated limbs, natural hands with five fingers if visible, avoid fingers pinching tiny objects. No smartphones, watches, modern devices or modern payment cards. No gloomy black background.
